selection_policy.block_reference_rule: Every town block declares structure_variant_id and purpose_id from this profile.
selection_policy.visual_sanity_rule: Variants should render as purposeful silhouettes on authored foundations; no arbitrary crossing lines.
selection_policy.interior_policy_rule: Only highlighted buildings may stream interiors; exterior-only structures remain landmark/service anchors.
selection_policy.future_density_rule: Residential and worker-housing variants may later reserve capacity through NPC/home assignment files.
